method: Direct inspection of six timestamp-matched source/commanded/measured RGB thumbnails; unblinded qualitative assessment, not full-video review.
observations: Both arms retain the table, chairs and wall displays at all six sampled timestamps; no near-total scene collapse is visible.
Both outputs show increased contrast/saturation at frame 85 compared with frame 84.
Later frames change the right-hand foreground and room framing relative to the source reference.
Mean position reduction is only 0.000234 anchor units (2.53%); no matched regeneration/noise floor is available. Endpoint rotation worsens despite lower mean rotation.
classification: Small numeric pose improvement with retained scene content and appearance drift; efficacy not established.
temporal_limitation: Static sampled thumbnails do not resolve physical camera reversal, exclude between-sample collapse, or quantify perceptual video quality.
